# Test Infrastructure Improvements

## Issues Found
1. Runtime error: Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime in metadata.rs
2. Metadata initialization bug: reads SQLite binary as UTF-8 text
3. Tests expect old 'stack' file format instead of SQLite 'stak.db'

## Work Items
- Fix block_on in SqliteMetadataBackend (use spawn_blocking)
- Fix init handler to properly detect existing SQLite database
- Update tests to use support module (eliminate duplication)
- Update tests to check for stak.db instead of stack file

## Test Audit Findings
- Strong BDD naming (Dan North)
- Good integration coverage (Testing Trophy)
- Massive code duplication across test files
- Missing property-based testing
- support/mod.rs exists but underutilized
